item.title: No, UN chief Guterres did not call Francesca Albanese 'out of control'
item.description: Pro-Israel lobby group UN Watch has alleged that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres referred to Francesca Albanese, the UN's Special Rapporteur on Palestine, as "out of control", saying he'd previously called her a "horrible woman". But Guterres named no one in his remarks. He said "many" independent rapporteurs were "totally out of control", without singling out any individual. The UN has since said that linking the comment specifically to Albanese is a "misreading" of his remarks. Vedika Bahl fact-checks. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Israelis shoot dead two Palestinian teenagers after settlers encircle village
item.description: Troops escort settlers into al-Mughayyir and raze village outside Hebron as ethnic cleansing of West Bank continues Israelis have shot dead two teenagers in a Palestinian village encircled by settlers, and Israeli troops have razed an entire village outside Hebron, in the latest attacks in a surge of Israeli terror and ethnic cleansing across the occupied West Bank. The shootings targeted Khalil Abu Alia, 16, who was about to start 11th grade at the al-Mughayyir boys school, and 19-year-old Omar al-Nassan, who graduated from the same institution with top marks this summer. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Vance defiende el acuerdo petrolero con Venezuela como escudo ante la crisis con Irán
item.description: Ante las dudas y críticas sobre el nuevo acuerdo petrolero de Donald Trump con Venezuela, su vicepresidente, J. D. Vance, salió este jueves en la Casa Blanca a defenderlo y a presentarlo como una pieza de la estrategia de Washington para blindar a EE.UU. frente a futuras crisis energéticas , en un momento de creciente beligerancia con Irán y de encarecimiento de los combustibles. Vance sostuvo que Washington no puede depender de que otros países garanticen el suministro mundial de energía y cargó además contra los aliados europeos, entre ellos España, por lo que describió como su incapacidad… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Far-right Israeli minister outlines plan for removal of all Palestinians from Gaza
item.description: Itamar Ben-Gvir claims proposal for illegal forced displacement of 2 million people is ‘realistic’ and ‘concrete’ Israel’s far-right national security minister has set out a plan for the illegal forced expulsion of all Palestinians from the Gaza Strip, with the intention of sending them abroad. Speaking in the run-up to close-fought Israeli elections, Itamar Ben-Gvir said the plan aimed to remove 250,000 Palestinians from Gaza in the first year, followed by the rest of its population of roughly 2 million over the next six years. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
